firstHandoff.description: Upgrade-only one-time legacy credential/ownership handoff selector; it does not replace the backup gate required on every upgrade.

backupVerified.description: Must be true on every Helm upgrade because the authority bootstrap applies on every upgrade, including a no-op replay.

parityVerified.description: Must be true on every Helm upgrade after backup restore and database/application parity have been verified.

backupReference.description: Non-secret backup evidence identifier required on every Helm upgrade; empty is permitted only for fresh-install values.
